claims.description: Dry-run derives the current envelope matrix demand, checked-in baseline sum, and 10% headroom without truncation.

Runner tests prove per-flow attempted, completed, budget-skipped, and required-sample accounting, including a flow that reports incomplete because a pre-call skip drops attempted below required with zero budget-skips.

Gate tests prove zero/partial exhaustion fails closed while incomplete coverage is excluded from BaselineDrift, an incomplete flow absent from baseline.json still fails the coverage gate, and --update-baseline refuses to accept (gate) or write (index.ts seed-guard) incomplete coverage.
Index summary code prints configured versus required demand and per-flow coverage.

Pure mastery budget tests cover the complete grid, changed counts, 215 rejection, 216 acceptance, and derive that 216 configured versus 192 expected leaves exactly three 8-call reproduce rounds for one offender.

Workflow comments record matrix-derived envelope provider demand including internal judge calls, sequential estimated provider demand, and gate-specific caps. Timeout re-verification: the comment projects each gate's retained-run-30721918215 wall clock (envelope 839s, teaching 271s, mastery 710s) onto CURRENT demand via ratios grounded in that run's own log (envelope 366/300, teaching 5/5, mastery 24/21) to ~35.1 min / ~5.1x headroom under the unchanged 180-minute timeout-minutes, with explicit uncertainty (single run, no P90, 2 failed envelope OUTER invocations, queue/latency variance, and a disclosure that 29 of that run's 33 skips were budget-exceeded - 10 judge-bearing cases and 19 non-judge-bearing cases, not all 29 judge-bearing). No paid live run performed; timeout-minutes itself unchanged. Review-fix round 1 (M1+S1): parsed timeout-minutes instead of hardcoding 180 (mutation-proven); labeled the 300 denominator as an outer-invocation cap, not a measured provider-call count. Review-fix round 2 (SHOULD-1/2): replaced loose ratio toContain checks with numBoundary-guarded regexes (superset-proof); added the 29-skip disclosure. Skip-split correction round (1 MUST_FIX): corrected the round-2 disclosure's flow-vs-case conflation (16/13 -> derived 10/19), proven by mutation RED/GREEN. S1/S2 round (0 MUST_FIX/2 SHOULD_FIX): (S1) removed a second argument passed to enumerateScenarios at two call sites (declared arity 1, produced TS2554, uncaught by any existing typecheck target since none reaches scripts/); added a focused TS-compiler-API type probe (scripts/eval-live-gate-independence-typecheck.test.ts) asserting zero TS2554 diagnostics, RED/GREEN-proven. (S2, CodeRabbit 3701613388) the envelope/teaching/mastery duration-x-ratio regexes searched the whole workflowComments string without requiring their gate label, so a swapped/mislabelled pair would still pass; extracted the AC-6 projection sentence into a bounded string and required each regex to include its gate label, proven by a swapped-label ('envelope'->'mastery') mutation RED then byte-identical revert GREEN.

Deterministic workflow-contract tests pin derived provider-demand relationships, omitted-cap preflight ordering, runtime order, and changed counts without a fixed envelope-only assertion. A dedicated focused type probe (scripts/eval-live-gate-independence-typecheck.test.ts) additionally pins that the workflow-contract suite itself carries no TS2554 argument-count errors, closing a gap no other typecheck target reaches.
